notes: Build a mounted runtime image that carries a source-built OpenCode CLI plus glibc and musl Node runtimes under the runtime root.
The runtime emits POSIX sh-compatible runtime-env.sh and bin wrappers so mounted execution works in Alpine/musl task containers.
The runtime build applies a local patch that lets openai-compatible providers disable streaming while preserving canonical tool-call traces.
The corresponding Harbor custom agent is harbor.agents.custom.opencode:CustomOpenCode.
